body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Plantronics introduced 'K100', speakerphone for car at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'K100' has GPS navigation functionality supporting Bluetooth and listening music and watching TV are possible. When calling during moving, it can be used as speakerphone. The price is 79.99USD.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
